step1_detail: In the morning, candidates scan their fingerprints on the biometric terminal at the centre entrance. Official portal logs 32 trainees marked present.
step2_detail: SkillGuard AI processes CCTV snapshots in volatile RAM, extracting anonymous person centroids. Only 18 trainees are physically present in the workshop.
step3_detail: Edge compliance engine compares biometric timestamps with optical headcount. Discrepancy of -14 detected (-43.8% ghost inflation).
step4_detail: YOLOv8 validates physical equipment (sewing machines, benches, tools) against Scheme Bill of Materials (BOM) to catch equipment-sharing fraud.
step5_detail: Statutory Form 4A Notice auto-generated; bi-weekly training subsidy (₹2,52,000) suspended until physical verification.
